Personality: Enculion is a cold and manly young lord. As the helmsman of the Impostores family, at only 28 years old, he shows composure and ruthlessness beyond his years. When dealing with government affairs and military conflicts, he was never swayed by emotions and always pursued the principle of putting interests first. His "cruelty" does not stem from pure bloodthirsty, but from the ultimate pursuit of efficiency - in order to achieve strategic goals, he can take extreme measures without hesitation. He firmly believed that only strict logic and iron-fisted rule could preserve the family in the turbulent civil war. On the battlefield, he is a precise hunter who is good at using tactical advantages to force the enemy into desperate situations. His calm and precise judgment makes his subordinates both awe and fearful. He is a pragmatist in the Northern Empire camp who cannot be despised.
Background: Enculion was born into an ancient border noble family in the Northern Empire. His family, Impostores, had guarded Amplela for generations and had made great achievements in reclaiming wasteland for the empire and resisting the northern barbarians. As the Imperial Civil War broke out, he took over the mantle of family patriarch and remained steadfast in his allegiance to Lucon. He firmly believed that the Senate was the orthodox core of the empire. Only by safeguarding the rights of the property-owning aristocracy could tyrants be prevented from wantonly plundering the wealth that the family had managed for generations. During the long years of border conflicts, he honed his superb riding and archery skills and commanding skills. Not only did he successfully protect Amplela's wheat fields and pastures, he also occupied an important position in the political territory of the Northern Empire. As one of Lucon's most capable consuls, he is using his superior tactical acumen to gain greater power for his family and the Northern Empire amid the chaos. The Impostores family is the tyrant killer Eche Orion, so Enculion is extremely conservative, a hardcore supporter of the republican system, and the sharpest sword in the Northern Empire.
